NEXT_SCIENTIFIC_DIRECTION: Increase independent visible/no-wall trajectory and layout coverage, then evaluate the token-preserving visible-position readout on a new untouched grouped evaluation authority before deciding whether mean pooling should be replaced for any future hidden-state study.

findings_preserved.statement: Current trajectory scaling does not show a coherent upward trend and is dominated by trajectory composition.

Token-preserving decoding materially improves aggregate held-out R2 over mean pooling, but the improvement reverses direction across the two held-out layouts, so a stable pooling bottleneck is not established.

interpretation_note: This is not a failed token probe. The token diagnostic found substantial exploratory evidence that spatial token identity can matter for visible-position readout; under the current authority that evidence is layout-dependent, which is why the adjudication is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than a negative result.
scope_limitations: Layer 4 was preselected from an existing positive control, not searched under this authority.
Two held-out layouts (L03, L04) cannot separate layout identity from sample size.
Adjacent frames within a trajectory are correlated, so frame counts overstate independent sample size.
